definitions.explanation: A product or item made according to specific customer requirements rather than being mass-produced. Implies customization in size, material, design, or other specifications.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特注|とくちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{特注|とくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Custom-made furniture is expensive but lasts a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{特注|とくちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頼|たの}んでいる→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: Since I'm large, I always order shoes custom-made.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧ (special order). Used as a noun or as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective: {特注|とくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧ (a custom-made item), {特注|とくちゅう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (custom product). Common in contexts involving clothing, furniture, equipment, and any goods that can be tailored to individual specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特注|とくちゅう}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: custom-made product
- {特注|とくちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to have custom-made
- {特注|とくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧: custom furniture
- {特注|とくちゅう}⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: custom size
